question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word 'zest' in the given sentence.

The peppy and energetic music of the DJ was able to remove the passivity and dullness present in the party.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (dullness)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"zest"** means great enthusiasm and energy. It refers to a lively interest or excitement in something. (जोश, ऊर्जा)

 
 
• **Example:** She approached every task with zest, making her a joy to work with.
 
 
 
• **"Dullness"** is the opposite of zest. It refers to a lack of excitement, energy, or enthusiasm, often indicating monotony or inactivity. (नीरसता, थकान)
 
 
• **Example:** The dullness of the lecture made it hard for the students to stay awake.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of "zest" is "dullness."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (dullness)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Remove** (हटाना): To take away or eliminate something.

 
 
• **Example:** Please remove the unnecessary files from your desktop.
 
 
 
• **Energetic** (ऊर्जावान): Being full of energy, lively, or active.
 
 
• **Example:** The energetic performance of the dancer mesmerized the audience.
 
 
 
• **Peppy** (चुस्त): Full of vitality or liveliness.
 
 
• **Example:** The peppy music lifted everyone's spirits.
